verdict.rationale: Openness of source is a fair question for a scheduling SaaS, since open-source competitors exist, so the axis applies. The only related item is an open-source page listing SavvyCal's 'contributions to the community', which does not show that SavvyCal's own product source is published under an open license. The rest of the pack covers the hosted REST API, webhooks and embed library, which are not source access.
